phases.narrative_purpose: Adapt the continuous working story into sequential film beats.
phases.broad_progression: Follow the expanded story from beginning to end without changing event order or outcomes.

required_events.event: Amy flips eggs onto a sizzling skillet while Will laughs in the hallway and Amber stacks cereal bowls on the counter, sunlight streaming through blinds.
A zombie groans at the front door, lurches inside, and Amy grabs Will's hand and pulls Amber behind the back bedroom door, slamming it shut with a quick flick of her wrist.
Heart pounding, she darts back into the kitchen in one breathless stride, retrieves a hidden pistol and katana from beneath the counter, ready for battle.
The first zombie shuffles forward again as Amy swings the katana in a swift arc that slices its head off, collapsing it with a wet thud.

A second lunges from the hallway and she fires the pistol, one bullet finding bone as the zombie crumples; a third appears at the doorway, and Amy spins to slash across its torso until the body shatters on the floor.
More zombies burst in—fourth, fifth, sixth—and each time she takes them down with precise strikes or single shots, cutting through the groaning bodies before they reach her.
When the last zombie drops to the floor, its eyes still wide in death, Amy breathes out slowly and steps back into the dim back bedroom.
She grabs Will's hand again, pulls Amber close, and together they step out of the door, leaving behind scattered bodies while a kitchen that smells faintly of fried eggs settles around them.
